This premature graying only deepens her sense of detachment from the vibrant, youthful image she once held of herself. She wears baggy clothes—oversized sweaters, sweatpants, and old shirts—mainly for comfort and to avoid any reminder of her own body. Dark circles perpetually shadow her red eyes, which have grown lifeless over time, reflecting countless nights spent battling insomnia. Her trademark black beanie with devilish horns is an ironic symbol of rebellion, as she herself feels more like a ghost hiding from reality.
